mechanical_height_audit.conclusion: Known fixed central compute/power/RF parts remain <=3.25 mm and pass the 6.5 mm gross cavity screen. External connector screening changes the mechanical verdict: USB-A has effectively zero gross tolerance margin, the screened Micro-Fit power header needs more than 6.5 mm under the conservative screen, and the screened right-angle RCA family is the dominant ~10 mm Z driver. The 6 mm legacy standoff/Z-stack therefore remains candidate-only until local perimeter relief or an alternate connector strategy is proven.
